targets.rawSql:
SELECT sp.edition AS "Edition"
FROM collect.server_properties AS sp
WHERE sp.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY sp.collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(sp.product_update_level, '') <> ''
         THEN sp.product_version || ' (' || sp.product_update_level || ')'
         ELSE sp.product_version END AS "Version"
FROM collect.server_properties AS sp
WHERE sp.server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY sp.collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN sqlserver_start_time IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
    ELSE (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LOCALTIMESTAMP - sqlserver_start_time)) / 86400)::int || 'd '
         || ((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LOCALTIMESTAMP - sqlserver_start_time))::bigint
              % 86400) / 3600) || 'h'
    END AS "Uptime"
FROM collect.server_properties
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT sqlserver_cpu_utilization + COALESCE(other_process_cpu_utilization, 0) AS v
FROM collect.v_cpu_utilization_stats
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH per_collection AS (
    SELECT
        collection_time,
        SUM(delta_wait_time_ms) AS total_delta_ms,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('second', collection_time)
            - date_trunc('second', LAG(collection_time) OVER (ORDER BY collection_time))))
            AS interval_seconds
    FROM collect.v_wait_stats
    WHERE collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '1 hour'
      AND server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY collection_time
)
SELECT CASE WHEN interval_seconds > 0
            THEN total_delta_ms::double precision / interval_seconds ELSE 0 END AS v
FROM per_collection
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH bpr AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS c
    FROM collect.v_blocked_process_reports
    WHERE collection_time >= date_trunc('day', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AND server_id IN (${server:csv})
),
dmv AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS c
    FROM collect.v_dmv_blocking_snapshots
    WHERE collection_time >= date_trunc('day', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AND server_id IN (${server:csv})
),
deadlocks AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS c
    FROM collect.v_deadlocks
    WHERE collection_time >= date_trunc('day', (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AND server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT c FROM bpr), 0), (SELECT c FROM dmv), 0)
       + (SELECT c FROM deadlocks) AS v

SELECT CASE WHEN total_server_memory_mb > 0
            THEN buffer_pool_mb::double precision / total_server_memory_mb * 100 END AS v
FROM collect.v_memory_stats
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
ORDER BY collection_time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        cl.server_id,
        cl.collector_name,
        COUNT(*) AS total_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cl.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cl.status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_count,
        AVG(cl.duration_ms) AS avg_duration_ms,
        /* SKIPPED counts as a healthy run: dedup and version-gated collectors no-op
           without being stale. */
        MAX(CASE WHEN cl.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'SKIPPED') THEN cl.collection_time END)
            AS last_success_time,
        MAX(cl.collection_time) AS last_run_time,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cl.status IN ('ERROR', 'PERMISSIONS') THEN cl.error_message END)
            AS last_error,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cl.status IN ('ERROR', 'PERMISSIONS') THEN cl.collection_time END)
            AS last_error_time,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cl.status = 'PERMISSIONS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            AS permission_denied_count,
        /* YIELDED = the 1s lock-timeout guard fired: deliberate and benign for collection,
           counted apart from errors because it says something about the monitored server's
           lock contention rather than about monitoring. */
        SUM(CASE WHEN cl.status = 'YIELDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yield_count
    FROM collect.v_collection_log AS cl
    WHERE cl.collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '7 days'
      AND cl.server_id IN (${server:csv})
    GROUP BY cl.server_id, cl.collector_name
),
cadence(collector_name, frequency_minutes) AS (VALUES
    ('ag_database_replica_states', 1),
        ('ag_replica_states', 1),
        ('agent_status', 5),
        ('blocked_process_report', 1),
        ('cpu_scheduler_stats', 1),
        ('cpu_utilization', 1),
        ('database_config', 0),
        ('database_scoped_config', 0),
        ('database_size_stats', 60),
        ('deadlocks', 1),
        ('default_trace_events', 5),
        ('dmv_blocking_snapshot', 1),
        ('file_io_stats', 1),
        ('index_object_stats', 1440),
        ('job_history', 5),
        ('latch_stats', 1),
        ('long_query_completions', 1),
        ('memory_clerks', 5),
        ('memory_grant_stats', 1),
        ('memory_pressure_events', 5),
        ('memory_stats', 1),
        ('perfmon_stats', 1),
        ('plan_cache_stats', 5),
        ('procedure_stats', 1),
        ('query_snapshots', 1),
        ('query_stats', 1),
        ('query_store', 5),
        ('running_jobs', 5),
        ('server_config', 0),
        ('server_properties', 0),
        ('session_stats', 5),
        ('session_summary_stats', 5),
        ('spinlock_stats', 1),
        ('system_health_events', 5),
        ('tempdb_stats', 1),
        ('trace_flags', 0),
        ('wait_stats', 1),
        ('waiting_tasks', 1)
),
a AS (
    SELECT
        agg.*,
        COALESCE(c.frequency_minutes, 0) AS frequency_minutes,
        CASE WHEN agg.total_runs > 0
             THEN agg.error_count::double precision / agg.total_runs * 100
             ELSE 0 END AS failure_rate,
        COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - agg.last_success_time))
                 / 3600.0, 999) AS hours_since_success
    FROM agg
    LEFT JOIN cadence c ON c.collector_name = agg.collector_name
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILING') AS v
FROM (SELECT CASE
        WHEN a.total_runs = 0 THEN 'NEVER_RUN'
        WHEN a.permission_denied_count > 0 AND a.error_count = 0 AND a.success_count = 0
            THEN 'NO_PERMISSIONS'
        WHEN a.collector_name IN ('server_config', 'database_config', 'database_scoped_config', 'trace_flags', 'server_properties')
            THEN CASE WHEN a.failure_rate > 20.0 THEN 'WARNING'
                      ELSE 'HEALTHY' END
        WHEN a.hours_since_success
             > GREATEST(24.0,
                        2.0 * a.frequency_minutes / 60.0)
            THEN 'FAILING'
        WHEN a.hours_since_success
             > GREATEST(4.0,
                        1.5 * a.frequency_minutes / 60.0)
            THEN 'STALE'
        WHEN a.failure_rate > 20.0 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'HEALTHY'
    END AS status FROM a) AS x

WITH samples AS (
SELECT
    cpu.sample_time
        - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
          * ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
                MAX(cpu.sample_time) OVER (PARTITION BY cpu.server_id, cpu.collection_time)
                - cpu.collection_time
            )) / 900.0)::double precision AS time,
    cpu.sqlserver_cpu_utilization AS sql_cpu,
    cpu.sqlserver_cpu_utilization + COALESCE(cpu.other_process_cpu_utilization, 0) AS total_cpu
FROM collect.v_cpu_utilization_stats AS cpu
WHERE $__timeFilter(cpu.collection_time)
  AND cpu.server_id IN (${server:csv})
),

ref AS (
    SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamp AS ref_time
),
buckets AS (
    
SELECT
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM collection_time)::int AS hour_of_day,
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM collection_time)::int AS day_of_week,
    SUM(sqlserver_cpu_utilization)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(sqlserver_cpu_utilization), 0) AS mean_val,
    sqrt(GREATEST(
        (SUM(power(sqlserver_cpu_utilization, 2)) - POWER(SUM(sqlserver_cpu_utilization), 2)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(sqlserver_cpu_utilization), 0))
        / NULLIF(COUNT(sqlserver_cpu_utilization) - 1, 0), 0)) AS stddev_val,
    COUNT(sqlserver_cpu_utilization) AS sample_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT collection_time::date) AS distinct_days
FROM collect.v_cpu_utilization_stats, ref
WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
AND   collection_time >= ref.ref_time - INTERVAL '30 days'
AND   collection_time <  ref.ref_time
GROUP BY 1, 2

),
target AS (
    SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ref_time)::int AS hour_of_day,
           EXTRACT(DOW FROM ref_time)::int AS day_of_week
    FROM ref
),
full_bucket AS (
    SELECT b.mean_val, b.stddev_val, b.sample_count
    FROM buckets b, target t
    WHERE b.hour_of_day = t.hour_of_day AND b.day_of_week = t.day_of_week
),
hour_mean AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(b.mean_val * b.sample_count) / NULLIF(SUM(b.sample_count), 0) AS grand_mean,
        SUM(b.sample_count) AS sample_count
    FROM buckets b, target t
    WHERE b.hour_of_day = t.hour_of_day
),
hour_bucket AS (
    SELECT
        hm.grand_mean AS mean_val,
        CASE WHEN hm.sample_count > 1 THEN sqrt(GREATEST(SUM(
            (b.stddev_val * b.stddev_val) * GREATEST(b.sample_count - 1, 0)
            + b.sample_count * (b.mean_val - hm.grand_mean) * (b.mean_val - hm.grand_mean)
        ) / (hm.sample_count - 1), 0)) ELSE 0 END AS stddev_val,
        hm.sample_count
    FROM buckets b, target t, hour_mean hm
    WHERE b.hour_of_day = t.hour_of_day
    GROUP BY hm.grand_mean, hm.sample_count
),
flat_mean AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(b.mean_val * b.sample_count) / NULLIF(SUM(b.sample_count), 0) AS grand_mean,
        SUM(b.sample_count) AS sample_count
    FROM buckets b
),
flat_bucket AS (
    SELECT
        fm.grand_mean AS mean_val,
        CASE WHEN fm.sample_count > 1 THEN sqrt(GREATEST(SUM(
            (b.stddev_val * b.stddev_val) * GREATEST(b.sample_count - 1, 0)
            + b.sample_count * (b.mean_val - fm.grand_mean) * (b.mean_val - fm.grand_mean)
        ) / (fm.sample_count - 1), 0)) ELSE 0 END AS stddev_val,
        fm.sample_count
    FROM buckets b, flat_mean fm
    GROUP BY fm.grand_mean, fm.sample_count
),
selected AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN (SELECT sample_count FROM full_bucket) >= 10 THEN (SELECT mean_val FROM full_bucket)
            WHEN (SELECT sample_count FROM hour_bucket) >= 10 THEN (SELECT mean_val FROM hour_bucket)
            WHEN (SELECT sample_count FROM flat_bucket) >= 3 THEN (SELECT mean_val FROM flat_bucket)
        END AS mean_val,
        CASE
            WHEN (SELECT sample_count FROM full_bucket) >= 10 THEN (SELECT stddev_val FROM full_bucket)
            WHEN (SELECT sample_count FROM hour_bucket) >= 10 THEN (SELECT stddev_val FROM hour_bucket)
            WHEN (SELECT sample_count FROM flat_bucket) >= 3 THEN (SELECT stddev_val FROM flat_bucket)
        END AS stddev_val,
        CASE
            WHEN (SELECT sample_count FROM full_bucket) >= 10 THEN (SELECT sample_count FROM full_bucket)
            WHEN (SELECT sample_count FROM hour_bucket) >= 10 THEN (SELECT sample_count FROM hour_bucket)
            WHEN (SELECT sample_count FROM flat_bucket) >= 3 THEN (SELECT sample_count FROM flat_bucket)
        END AS sample_count
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT
        mean_val,
        CASE
            WHEN sample_count IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN mean_val = 0 AND COALESCE(stddev_val, 0) <= 0 THEN 0
            ELSE GREATEST(stddev_val, mean_val * 0.01, 5.0)
        END AS effective_stddev,
        sample_count
    FROM selected
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT
        mean_val,
        mean_val + 2 * effective_stddev AS upper_val,
        GREATEST(0, mean_val - 2 * effective_stddev) AS lower_val
    FROM baseline
    WHERE sample_count > 0 AND effective_stddev > 0
)

LEFT JOIN alerts al ON al.server_id = s.server_id AND al.d = s.d
) AS raw_tier WHERE (CASE WHEN $__timeFrom() >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 days' THEN 'raw' WHEN $__timeFrom() < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 days' AND $__timeFrom() >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' ELSE 'hourly' END WHEN $__timeFrom() < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'daily' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) AND (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) AND (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' ELSE 'daily' END END) = 'raw')
SELECT
    d.day AS "Day",
    srv.name AS "Server",
    CASE CASE
        WHEN d.deadlock_count > 0
          OR d.collection_errors > 0
          OR d.memory_critical_events > 0
          OR d.high_cpu_events >= 6
          OR d.blocking_events >= 11
        THEN 3
        WHEN d.high_cpu_events >= 1
          OR d.blocking_events >= 1
          OR d.memory_pressure_events > 0
          OR d.alert_count >= 1
        THEN 2
        ELSE 1
    END WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' END AS "Health",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(', ',
        CASE WHEN d.deadlock_count > 0
        THEN to_char(d.deadlock_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' ' || CASE WHEN d.deadlock_count = 1 THEN 'deadlock' ELSE 'deadlocks' END
    END,
        CASE WHEN d.collection_errors > 0
        THEN to_char(d.collection_errors, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' ' || CASE WHEN d.collection_errors = 1 THEN 'collection error' ELSE 'collection errors' END
    END,
        CASE WHEN d.high_cpu_events > 0
        THEN to_char(d.high_cpu_events, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' ' || CASE WHEN d.high_cpu_events = 1 THEN 'high-CPU sample' ELSE 'high-CPU samples' END
    END,
        CASE WHEN d.blocking_events > 0
        THEN to_char(d.blocking_events, 'FM999,999,999,990')
             || CASE WHEN d.blocking_events = 1 THEN ' blocking event' ELSE ' blocking events' END
             || CASE WHEN d.peak_block_wait_ms > 0
                     THEN ' (peak block ' || CASE
        WHEN d.peak_block_wait_ms < 1000 THEN to_char(d.peak_block_wait_ms, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' ms'
        WHEN d.peak_block_wait_ms < 60000 THEN to_char(round(((d.peak_block_wait_ms) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || ' s'
        ELSE to_char(round(((d.peak_block_wait_ms) / 60000.0)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || ' min'
    END || ')'
                     ELSE '' END
    END,
        CASE WHEN d.memory_critical_events > 0
        THEN to_char(d.memory_critical_events, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' ' || CASE WHEN d.memory_critical_events = 1 THEN 'severe memory-pressure event' ELSE 'severe memory-pressure events' END
    END,
        CASE WHEN GREATEST(0, d.memory_pressure_events - d.memory_critical_events) > 0
        THEN to_char(GREATEST(0, d.memory_pressure_events - d.memory_critical_events), 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' ' || CASE WHEN GREATEST(0, d.memory_pressure_events - d.memory_critical_events) = 1 THEN 'memory-pressure event' ELSE 'memory-pressure events' END
    END,
        CASE WHEN d.alert_count > 0
        THEN to_char(d.alert_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' ' || CASE WHEN d.alert_count = 1 THEN 'alert' ELSE 'alerts' END
    END
    ), ''), 'No issues detected.') AS "Why",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(d.top_wait_type, ''), 'none') AS "Top Wait",
    d.total_wait_sec AS "Total Wait",
    d.unique_queries AS "Unique Queries",
    d.high_cpu_events AS "High-CPU Samples",
    d.deadlock_count AS "Deadlocks",
    d.blocking_events AS "Blocking Events",
    d.peak_block_wait_ms AS "Peak Block",
    d.memory_pressure_events AS "Memory Pressure",
    d.memory_critical_events AS "Severe Memory",
    d.collection_errors AS "Collection Errors",
    d.alert_count AS "Alerts"
FROM d
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = d.server_id
ORDER BY d.day DESC, srv.name
